title: Kestrel Limited Warranty Benefit Limits Schedule
content:
The money limits of the Kestrel limited warranty included with Vehicle Purchase Agreements are set by vehicle program.

| Vehicle program | Deductible per approved claim | Most Kestrel pays on one claim after the deductible | Most Kestrel pays across all claims on the order | Highest hourly labor rate recognized | Rental per day | Most rental days per claim | Towing per claim, at most |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | $100.00 | $1500.00 | $2500.00 | $110.00 | $0.00 | 0 | $0.00 |
| Kestrel Inspected | $50.00 | $3000.00 | $6000.00 | $125.00 | $35.00 | 3 | $75.00 |
| Kestrel Certified | $0.00 | $5000.00 | $9000.00 | $140.00 | $35.00 | 5 | $100.00 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | $0.00 | $7500.00 | $12000.00 | $150.00 | $40.00 | 5 | $100.00 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | $0.00 | $10000.00 | $18000.00 | $185.00 | $60.00 | 7 | $150.00 |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | $0.00 | $5000.00 | $9000.00 | $150.00 | $40.00 | 5 | $100.00 |

**Reading the schedule.** Under Kestrel Value Line the rental and towing figures are zero, so no rental or towing amount is reimbursed under that program.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a Kestrel Inspected order, an approved claim with a four-night repair reaches the 3-day rental limit, which at $35.00 a day comes to $105.00.
